competences.description: Attacks all enemies to leave a Branding effect for 2 turns.
Increases the Attack Power for 2 turns, and then attacks all enemies 3 times. Gains 1 stack of Chaos Force whenever attacking an enemy granted with Brand.
Attacks all enemies. Gains 5 stacks of Chaos Force if the boss attacks an enemy with 50% or less HP. When attacking branded enemies, Chaos Force increases by the number of those enemies.

Decreases the HP of all enemies by 1% per stack of Chaos Force, and then attacks all enemies. The damage dealt increases by 1% per stack of Chaos Force. This attack does not activate passive skills of the enemies.
